jobs.occupation: Business Analyst – Process Optimization & Data Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Execute comprehensive business analyses, including the definition of as-is and to-be process flows.
• Identify opportunities to improve data quality and streamline cross-departmental data exchange.
• Draft detailed user stories and establish clear acceptance criteria for technical teams.
• Monitor external IT suppliers and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) procedures.
• Facilitate stakeholder workshops and working groups to harmonize methodologies and requirements.
• Ensure thorough project documentation is maintained and accessible via collaboration tools.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in business analysis and process modeling using BPMN.
• You bring 3+ years of experience with PRINCE2 and Agile project management methodologies.
• You're proficient with 1+ years of experience in Jira and Confluence.
• You possess experience in functional analysis and drafting user stories.
• You have experience coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and quality control processes.
• You bring experience managing external IT vendors and their functional deliverables.
• You possess a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
• You're proactive, analytical, and strong in stakeholder management.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a good understanding of English and the other national language.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with complex data flows and multi-party data exchange projects.
• Previous experience within a government or public sector environment.
• Affinity with legal, judicial, or regulatory domains.

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.
As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.

You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.
You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.

Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

Profile

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

Our client is an international company headquartered in the Antwerpen region with over 30 years of experience at the international scale. They are looking for an IT Project Manager acting as a primary stakeholder in project coordination (applications and infrastructure) as well as technologies related to SAP within the company.

The IT Project Manager is a key stakeholder in project coordination concerning all IT-related matters within the company. This individual will collaborate with internal business stakeholders and external support partners to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. The role requires a business-focused expert who can advocate for user needs and take the necessary actions for planning and support.

Key responsibilities:

Business System Support:

• Act as a super-user and system expert for SAP (ERP), specifically for the S4Hana and Coupa modules (with 80% of the projects being finance-related).
• Understand the architecture and process flows of ERP, Process Control, and related manufacturing systems
• Monitor system health and stability.
• Troubleshoot and address system issues, outages, and functional needs, engaging support partners as needed
• Support business users as a subject matter expert on existing and proposed system functionality
• Act as program manager and project stakeholder for system upgrades and enhancements

End User Support:

• Act as the first responder for user desktop issues (hardware and software), engaging the help desk and support partners as needed.
• Facilitate requests for purchases.
• Observe and anticipate user needs, and make appropriate recommendations for improvement.

Infrastructure, Process and Policy:

• Assist users in understanding IT Policy, Process, and Systems.
• Support business leadership in strategic planning and project oversight.
• Coordinate site activities for upgrades and system maintenance.
• Make recommendations for enhancements that will improve system function, capabilities, and stability.

Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT or engineering field.
• Proven ability to work across functional and regional boundaries, challenge status quo, and handle multiple projects simultaneously while delivering on time and on budget.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication and change management skills.
• 3-8 years' experience in IT role in a global company.
• Mixed skills should include configuration and expertise in SAP Coupa and S4Hana.

Responsibilities

• Design and build Layer 3 data models and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines in a cloud environment.
• Integrate disparate data sources including demand, supply, and financial actuals into unified datasets.
• Develop and maintain advanced transformation flows to support migrations from legacy systems to modern architectures.
• Translate ambiguous business requirements into structured data solutions and actionable insights.
• Enable scalable reporting by building robust data models and dashboards for executive decision-making.
• Identify pragmatic AI use cases for forecasting improvements and trend detection.

Requirements

• 8+ years of data engineering experience focusing on Snowflake and expert-level SQL.
• 8+ years of experience in business intelligence using Tableau (Desktop and Prep) and Power BI.
• Extensive experience designing ETL/ELT frameworks and data transformation pipelines.
• In-depth functional knowledge of portfolio planning, resource forecasting, and financial planning.
• Proven expertise in data modeling and performance optimization for large-scale transformations.
• Strong experience integrating cross-domain enterprise data from systems like SAP HANA.
• You possess strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills to resolve cross-system data inconsistencies.
• You bring exceptional technical communication skills to engage with both IT and business stakeholders.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Planisware for portfolio and project data management.
• Knowledge of practical AI/ML applications and building flows with Copilot.
• Active knowledge of Dutch.

Work in an international IT environment where you’ll collaborate daily with engineers across Europe and take ownership of a diverse infrastructure.

Our partner is aninternational and well-established organisationwith operations across several European locations. Its IT environment supports a diverse international workforce and relies on a collaborative team of engineers to keep everything running smoothly.

 

As aSenior System Engineer, you will join a small and technically versatile IT team, working closely with engineers and colleagues across different countries. This is not a role limited to ticket resolution: you will work across1st, 2nd and 3rd line support, infrastructure, cloud and systems administration, while contributing to the continuous improvement of the IT environment.

Senior System Engineer - Your Profile

IT-Planet is the leading HR specialist for flexible and temporary staffing in IT. We manage IT projects for various Top 100 clients across Flanders and Brussels in the following IT domains: Application Development, Infrastructure Services & Software Testing. With 20 years’ experience under our belt, we are perfectly placed to meet your individual needs. With us, you can and are encouraged to grow and learn – in short, to thrive in your job. Sounds good? We are looking for an AI Governance Program Manager to join our Data & AI Governance team. As Program Manager, you will structure and drive the AI Governance Program to enable safe, compliant and accelerated AI adoption across the group. You will work in an agile, cross-functional environment to align stakeholders (IT, Data, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Business) and stand-up the operating model, processes, and controls that ensure trustworthy AI at scale. This opening target a seasoned, delivery-driven professional able to organize and coordinate a transversal governance program with multiple senior stakeholders.

As part of its transformation, the client is establishing a group-wide AI Governance capability covering policy, risk assessment, model lifecycle, documentation, monitoring, and auditability. This endeavour will require close collaboration with numerous domains and their business counterparts to define standards, codify processes, and embed governance into delivery teams. While they don’t expect the candidate to write policies single-handedly, the ability to structure content and prepare high-quality materials for expert review is a strong plus. You have the responsibility for the organization, coordination, and reporting on the progress of the AI Governance Program:

Program orchestration

• Build and maintain the program roadmap, backlog and milestones; manage RAID, dependencies, and interlocks.
• Establish governance rituals (steerco, working groups, decision logs, reporting) and ensure timely escalation with the CoE.
 

Standards & processes enablement

• Coordinate the definition and adoption of AI policies, standards, and guidelines (risk classification, data usage, transparency, human oversight, model documentation).
• Drive the design and rollout of AI lifecycle processes (use-case intake, risk assessment, validation, approvals, monitoring, incident handling, periodic review).
 

Stakeholder alignment

• Raise awareness and secure prioritization with contributing teams; facilitate workshops where specific support is needed.
• Prepare decision materials for executives; manage trade-offs in a politically sensitive, multi-stakeholder landscape.
 

Tooling & integration

• Coordinate assessment/selection of governance tooling (model registry, risk assessment workflow, monitoring, evidence repository); align with existing data Governance and Risk frameworks.
 

Quality, controls & reporting

• Ensure validation of deliverables and controls with contributing teams, measure adoption, compliance and effectiveness.
• Report progress to management lines and interest groups; handle escalations together with the Data Governance CoE.
 

Transition management

• Document the operating model and handover plan; support the recruitment/selection of the internal capability owner and ensure a smoot

Profile

• You hold a master’s degree in IT, Engineering, Business Engineering or equivalent experience.
• You have 5–10+ years in program/project management for transversal governance, regulatory or risk initiatives; AI/Data governance exposure is a strong plus.
• You have demonstrable experience orchestrating multi‑stakeholder programs with senior visibility and political sensitivity.
• You are comfortable operating in agile environments; familiarity with Scrum/Kanban is a plus.
• You are proactive, structured, and delivery‑driven, balancing pragmatism with compliance needs.
• You have excellent interpersonal & communication skills and adapt your style to technical and non‑technical audiences, including executives.
• You thrive in complex, evolving contexts and can structure ambiguity into clear decisions, actions, and tracking.
• You are fluent in English (written and spoken); French or Dutch is a plus.
• Familiarity with EU AI Act, GDPR intersections, model risk management, and audit requirements.
• Experience with Collibra or related governance platforms; exposure to ML model registries/monitoring.
• Background in risk assessment methodologies (e.g., impact assessments, control testing).

Responsibilities

• Collect and process production data from sources such as process historians, MES systems, and sensors.
• Develop robust data pipelines and analytical models using Python and SQL.
• Design and implement Machine Learning models for predictive maintenance and anomaly detection.
• Implement Large Language Model (LLM) applications for document processing and knowledge extraction.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate digital solutions into operational value.
• Document methodologies and results in compliance with GMP requirements.

Requirements

• You bring 3+ years of experience in a data science or analytical role.
• You have advanced proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation, including pandas, scikit-learn, and NumPy.
• You possess strong skills in SQL for relational database management and complex queries.
• You have practical experience building and validating Machine Learning models for time-series and predictive analysis.
• You bring knowledge of Large Language Models (LLM), including fine-tuning and prompt engineering.
• You have experience with IIoT data contextualization using AVEVA PI Asset Framework or Seeq.
• You possess a Master's or Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or Engineering.
• You are proactive, analytical, and solution-oriented.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in a GMP-regulated environment.
• Knowledge of WERUM PAS-X or other MES systems.
• Familiarity with DeltaV DCS or process control systems.
• Experience using Cursor or Claude for code development.

Responsibilities

• Coordinate the preparation and submission of proposals within the defined RFP process.
• Evaluate business requirements to ensure project outcomes meet organizational standards.
• Maintain clear communication channels with project managers and external stakeholders.
• Monitor submission deadlines and ensure all administrative requirements are fulfilled.
• Perform detailed analysis to support the project team in decision-making processes.
• Generate comprehensive documentation and status updates for management review.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of relevant experience in consulting or project coordination.
• You bring a proven track record in project management and stakeholder management.
• You possess experience with RFP processes and process analysis.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies.
• Willingness to obtain additional professional certifications.

It means your Java code is clean and efficient and you can assist cross-departmental teams with your interpersonal fluency to deliver high-quality software solutions. We are Team possible – the people behind Davinsi Labs, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Codit, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here!
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world. 
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do. 
Sounds like your kind of place?

Your job

What can you expect from this role? 

You will be part of our MSP teams focusing on Managed Detection and Response (MDR). The SRE team focuses on the backend platformization and automation side of the MDR service. Aspects like reliability, scalability, automation and efficiency of our managed service provider (MSP) technology stack are extremely important for Davinsi Labs. Your primary objective as an engineer will be to continuously enhance these capabilities across different complex customer environments. Your expertise and performance will directly impact the experience of our valued clients. The most relevant technologies for the SRE team are the following ones: 

• AWS
• GitHub
• Nutanix Prism
• HashiCorp Terraform
• HashiCorp Vault
• HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP)
• Ansible
• Microsoft Entra ID
• Microsoft Azure
• PingIdentity PingOne for customers
• Rocky Linux
Key responsibilities: 

• Design and implementation: You will be designing and implementing zero-touch production concepts across all levels of our MSP technology stack, leveraging applications Splunk Enterprise, Splunk Enterprise Security, Cribl Stream and Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR automation and orchestration capabilities to enhance operational efficiency. You will also be designing and implementing cloud infrastructure architecture, with a focus on AWS, Nutanix Prism, Microsoft Azure and Rocky Linux. This also includes IAM solutions, such as Single Sign-On (SSO), based on Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Automation: You'll develop automation capabilities for all value services, through CI/CD pipelines design and development.
• Version Control & Release Management: You'll be managing version control effectively using platforms such as GitHub. On the other hand, you'll be utilizing release management tools to streamline software deployment processes.
• Secret Management Solutions: Implementing secret management solutions like HashiCorp HCP Vault for MSP backends.
• Documentation: Generating and automating documentation using tools like Atlassian Confluence to ensure comprehensive system documentation. 

Your profile

 Hello, is it me you're looking for? 

• You have a strong background in computer science, computer engineering, or IT security (a degree is an asset).
• Experience with some of the following technologies: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Rocky Linux, Ansible, HashiCorp product portfolio, Microsoft Entra ID and PingIdentity PingOne.
• Experience with one or more of the following is highly recommended: Git, Atlassian Jira, Atlassian Confluence, Python v3, JavaScript.
• Affinity with threat detection platforms like SIEM technologies (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Stack, etc) and/or XDR technologies (Microsoft Defender XDR, Palo Alto Cortex XDR, etc) is an asset.
• You communicate in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. French is an asset.
• You are a problem solver with an analytical mind. As a team player with a positive attitude, you are always ready to challenge and to be challenged.

As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area. 

Your missions:
 
Customer & internal technical support
  
• Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors. 
• Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions 
• Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors. 
• Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team. 
• Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team. 
• Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.  
Continuous improvement & documentation
  
• Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement. 
• Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product). 
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. 
• Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams. 
• Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.  
Team
 
You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.
 
Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education: 
 
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function 
• Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions 
• Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides 
• Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)  
Your soft skills and personal qualities:
  
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers 
• Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation 
• Method, rigor and stress management 
• Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback 
• Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)
